transcript.text: This is Swift, an automated flood assistant working with local emergency services. Am I speaking with someone at 1416 Lerwick Drive?
Yeah, this is 1416 Lerwick Drive, just me and four others here, no water in yet, and we’re all good to stay put—no need to send anything over, not even a truck or boat, we’re totally fine.
Understood, you’re all staying put and fine. How many people are at the home right now, including anyone who can't come to the phone?
Just five of us here, all good, no one’s stuck inside or can’t make it to the phone—water’s not even in the house, so we’re totally fine.

You’re all safe and water’s not in the house. Is there anyone there who can't leave on their own, for example someone who uses a wheelchair, needs oxygen, or is bedbound? If it's a wheelchair, does it have a motor?
No one here can’t leave on their own, and no wheelchair or medical needs—just five of us, all good, no water in, and we’re all able to get out if needed.
Understood, everyone here can leave on their own. Is there water inside the home right now?
No water inside at all, just us five folks hanging tight, no need for any truck or boat help—everything’s dry and we’re good to go.
You’re staying dry and safe for now. If neighbors need a ride out, do you have a high-clearance truck, a boat, or free seats in a vehicle?
Nope, no truck, no boat, and I don’t have any free seats in a vehicle—everyone’s safe right here at 1416 Lerwick Drive, no one’s stranded or needing a ride out.
Everyone safe at 1416 Lerwick Drive, no one stranded. Let me read that back: 5 people; no water inside yet. Is that right?
Yeah, that’s right—five of us here, all good, no water in yet, and we’re not stranded, not even a speck of trouble.
Thanks for confirming you’re all safe and dry. I've recorded that everyone there can leave on their own. Don't drive through flooded roads. Turn around, don't drown. Goodbye.
